title: AgentManifest
description: An agent identity: a Keycloak client, its owner, risk tier, the tools it may use and the model classes it may call. Compiled into OPA data and the Keycloak realm import.

owner.description: The accountable human. Required even for scheduled agents; there is always someone to call.

kind.description: interactive: acts on behalf of a logged-in user; the token carries the user as subject and this agent in the actor chain. scheduled: runs without a user; authenticates with its own workload identity.

clientId.description: Keycloak client id. Generated into the realm import.

serviceAccount.description: Kubernetes service account whose projected token is federated into Keycloak. Scheduled agents only.

allowedTools.description: server/tool or server/* entries. tools/list for this agent is the intersection of these with the caller's group entitlement.

maxClassification.description: Ceiling on the classification of data this agent may handle. A tool whose outputClassification exceeds it is denied.

image.description: Image of the scheduled agent, pinned by digest.
